en: A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested valley. In the foreground are fields and scattered trees; behind them lies a compact village with traditional European houses and a prominent church with a steeple. On a hill above the village stands a sizable castle-like complex. The landscape extends into rolling hills in the background. The title text "Liebstadt i. S." is printed in red at the top.
